_note: M7-P9. Play-time limit per day (a grown-up setting), resets at local midnight. Default off. Time away from the game counts only up to maxGapSeconds. Wording: no guilt, no pressure, no countdowns shown to the child.
title: Play-time limit
help: Play time adds up each day and resets at midnight. When it is up, your child finishes their room and returns to the dojo. Nothing is lost.
wrapUpLine: Nice work, let's finish this room and rest!
doorResting: Your dojo is resting for today
